meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: Read how Loquor AAC handles local-first data, optional voice services, backups, and user-controlled privacy settings.

title: Privacy Policy - Loquor AAC
intro: Loquor AAC ("the App") is designed to give users a reliable communication voice using text, symbols, and optional speech synthesis. Your privacy is central to our design.

sections.title: 1. Data We Collect
paragraphs: Loquor AAC does not automatically collect personal data. All vocabulary, phrases, symbols, and settings are stored locally on your device only.
The App may store the following locally if you choose to use it:
items: Uploaded photos or symbols you assign to buttons
Usage frequency of phrases (for better suggestions)
Admin PIN (stored in hashed or encrypted form locally)

sections.title: 2. Data Not Collected
paragraphs: We do not collect, track, or store:
items: Any data used to identify you

sections.title: 3. Optional Voice Services (User-Initiated Only)
paragraphs: If you enter your own API key to use third-party voice services such as ElevenLabs, text you choose to speak may be sent to that provider only at the moment you press Speak.
Loquor AAC does not store or transmit your API key outside your device. Keys are kept in secure storage on the device.

sections.title: 4. Local Backups (User-Initiated Only)
paragraphs: You may export or back up your vocabulary manually. This is always initiated by you. We never upload backups without your action.

sections.title: 5. Data Security
paragraphs: Because data lives on your device:
items: Vocabulary can be hidden (masked), never auto-deleted
Admin PIN access is required to modify vocabulary
API keys, if entered, are stored using platform secure storage

sections.title: 6. Children's Privacy
paragraphs: Loquor AAC can be used by children, but the App itself does not collect data about age, identity, or behavior. Vocabulary is managed by caregivers using a local admin PIN.

sections.title: 7. Third-Party Libraries
paragraphs: The App uses open-source libraries for performance and offline storage. These libraries run on the device and do not transmit personal data.

sections.title: 8. Your Rights
paragraphs: Since no personal data is stored by us, there is nothing to request, delete, or withdraw from our servers. All your data stays in your control on your device.

sections.title: 9. Policy Updates
paragraphs: If this policy changes, the update will be posted inside the App and on our website. The effective date will be updated at the top.
